summary.intent: Fix PR #610 finding 01M7XSAZ95N3: replace the fixture's url.insteadOf origin rewrite (which broke canonical_git_remote and made the tag probe skip / ForeignTags bench fail) with a repo-local empty credential.helper and GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0, then merge main, push signed, and resolve the finding.
summary.outcome: Fixture reworked to keep HTTPS origin with empty credential.helper, and a new test asserts one ls-remote and no credential process; tests passed sandboxed and unsandboxed, full bench ran clean of UnsafeGitRemote, and lint passed. The commit was made and main re-merged, but the transcript ends before the push, ls-remote confirmation, trail link, and finding resolution are shown.

repo: The git process-count fixture lives in crates/callisto-fixtures/src/perf.rs and is exercised by crates/callisto-cli/tests/git_process_count_tests.rs, which counts git processes via GIT_TRACE2_EVENT start events.

url.insteadOf in the fixture also rewrites 'git remote get-url --push origin' to a local path, which binding.rs canonical_git_remote rejects as UnsafeGitRemote (local.rs:279), so any fixture origin must remain an HTTPS URL.

Network-dependent extra git processes come from credential helpers after a 401; setting repo-local credential.helper to empty and GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 makes ls-remote a single process regardless of network.

code.finding: Refactored git_processes into git_starts (returns start event lines) plus a count wrapper, and added release_dry_run_probes_origin_once_and_starts_no_credential_helper asserting exactly one ls-remote and zero credential processes.
Removed the insteadOf/bare-repo origin setup and replaced it with run_git(root, ["config","credential.helper",""]).

workflow: The task's no-session-trailer rule was initially violated in the first commit command (included a Claude-Session trailer) but the lint check failed to chain, so the commit was redone without the trailer.
Running the full `cargo bench -p callisto-cli --bench commands` with a timeout and grepping output for UnsafeGitRemote was used to confirm the ForeignTags shape no longer errors.
Tests were verified both sandboxed (network denied) and unsandboxed to prove count stability.

friction: Several initial Bash calls were redundant or failed (repeated fetch/grep attempts, a plain `just lint` failing until run via `rtk just lint`), wasting steps.
A background bench run had to be stopped and re-run directly.
The first combined lint/commit/merge/push command did not behave as intended (ran with a session trailer), requiring a redo.
